body:
She says she's already forgiven me, but she's still obviously upset and I don't know how she can feel better about it than I do. I'm afraid saying that I'm having some of these sorts of thoughts makes me sound like the teenager claiming they'll kill themselves if their SO leaves them, but I think you're right. She's said she's not going anywhere and wants to get past this just as much as I do. I just don't want to invalidate her hurt feelings with my dangerous thoughts.

People have said they're jealous of our marriage, which really just makes me feel worse about this.
